title: Digital Research PL/I-80 Language Manual
verification: Direct inspection of verified original local PDF/text; no assumption of point-release-wide v1.4 runtime equivalence.

rules.DOCUMENTED: Decimal(p,q) has p total digits, q fractional digits and sign. Defaults(7,0), constant form determines attributes. Larger scale assigned to smaller scale truncates; excessive integer digits cause FIXED OVERFLOW. Manual describes packed BCD.
For fixed-decimal multiplication result precision=min(15,p+r+1), scale=q+s. Insufficient decimal precision loses fractional digits.

selected_documentary_deductions.positive_assignment_to_7_2: Documentary fractional truncation gives expected28.12, not rounding28.13; no integer overflow for this mathematical value.

execution_limit: Literal intrinsic typing chain, numeric payload layout and multiplication-to-assignment implementation remain unproved. These documentary expectations are not linked-runtime observations.
